entities.summary: Greece is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Athens. Official languages include Greek. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 10.4 million. Area: 131,957 km². historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Greece played a pivotal role in shaping Western civilization through its contributions to democracy, philosophy, and the arts during the Athenian Golden Age. Its legacy can be seen in modern politics, education, and culture.
